data.title: 间桐樱 · 和室月华的温顺隐衷
data.action: 规矩端坐在和室榻榻米上，低垂着眼眸，纤细手指绞着睡衣带子，紫发长辫搭在胸前，神情温婉却带着一丝隐秘情愫，默默凝视着推门而入的学长。
data.location: 卫宫邸传统和室，月光透过日式障子木格窗在草席上投下清晰方格影
data.lighting: 皎洁月光穿透障子纸形成大面积柔白漫射，与走廊投进的微弱暖光形成静谧对比
data.mood: 传统大和抚子的极致顺从与深藏于心底的炽烈执念
data.description: 卫宫邸传统和室，月光透过日式障子木格窗在草席上投下清晰方格影。规矩端坐在和室榻榻米上，低垂着眼眸，纤细手指绞着睡衣带子，紫发长辫搭在胸前，神情温婉却带着一丝隐秘情愫，默默凝视着推门而入的学长。 她微微抬眸轻语——“学长……今晚的饭菜合您的口味吗？如果不介意的话……请让我一直服侍在您身边。”
data.promptProse: Seated neatly in formal seiza atop the woven tatami mats of a quiet traditional Japanese room at midnight, Sakura wears a cherry-blossom pink sheer silk cross-over camisole with translucent wide sleeves parted gently at the collar. Twisting the silken side-tie ribbon shyly between her slender fingers as her long braid drapes over her shoulder, she glances up quietly as crisp silver moonlight casts shoji lattice shadows across the room.
data.animaCaption: Seated neatly in seiza on the tatami mat in her cherry-blossom pink sheer silk cross-over camisole, Sakura twists the side ribbon shyly between her fingers with a tender blush. Silver moonlight filters through the shoji paper screen in clean lattice shadows.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a cherry-blossom pink double-layered sheer silk yukata-style camisole with a parted cross-over neckline, translucent wide sleeves, and a delicate side-tie ribbon.
